items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I'd hustle down there to hear him 'cause they had quite a long-term engagement in those days... I was just in wonderment at how they uh, it was like magic

ctx.x: … What was your perception of Ornette and Don Cherry and Billy Higgins when that hit?

Oh, just the uh, perception-wise, I was just totally blown away. I just uh, ever time I would come off the road uh, with J. J., I'd hustle down there to hear him 'cause they had quite a long-term engagement in those days. Uh, engagements were longer then, maybe six months or somethin'. And that's how long they were – or more – at the Five Spot, so I had a whole lot of opportunities to go and hear 'em. And I was just in wonderment at how they uh, it was like magic, you know, they had put this music together. Just…
